person_settled: Person-settled rows win. The UPDATE writes checks.arithmetic alone, only where the row still holds the filed run and still reads "unequal" (the machine's value). It never writes the record, checked, checked_by or checked_at: the trigger sets those from a person's verdict, a confirm marks the row checked and any other verdict (needs a fix) keeps it unchecked.
